newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast power sags with line restorations.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast power sags with line restorations.

text.p: Spot U.S. West Coast electricity prices sagged Wednesday in tandem with lower natural gas in the Southwest and the restoration of two California power transmission lines, industry sources said.
Southern California Edison said two 500 kilovolt transmission lines north of Los Angeles had been fully restored to service after being shut Tuesday due to nearby fires.
Easing natural gas swing prices were also said to have an impact on power.
"You can just watch (power) prices trail off as you watch San Juan natural gas prices trail off," said one marketer.

The Bonneville Power Administration was also reported to have stuck with the same prices it has maintained through the week, offering power at an average of about $19.19 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Thursday and Friday.
At the California-Oregon Border (COB), prices for firm, peak next-day delivery were quoted at $18.75-19.25 from $19.00-20.00 on Tuesday.
September COB power for firm, peak delivery was assessed lower at $17.75-18.20 from a Tuesday range of $17.80-18.20, the brokers and marketers said.
Peak COB electricity for the fourth quarter was assessed at $17.00-17.40, the sources said.
Off-peak, next-day COB was talked near $13.00, while off-peak September COB was discussed near $12.75.
At the Mid-Columbia (Mid-C) delivery point in Washington, firm, peak electricity prices for next-day delivery were quoted at $16.50-17.50 from a Tuesday range of $17.00-18.00.
September Mid-C electricity was pegged at $16.50-17.50 from $17.00-17.25 on Tuesday, the sources said.
At Palo Verde (PV), next-day electricity for peak, firm delivery was valued at near $23.00 from a Tuesday range of $24.50-27.00, the sources said.
September PV was reported to have eased to $20.50-21.05 from $21.00-21.25 on Tuesday.
October PV was talked in the $16.25-16.50 range, while fourth quarter PV was discussed at $16.45-16.50, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
